sections.title: How Guest WiFi Supports SMEs
text: Guest WiFi gives SMEs more than internet access. It’s a secure, cloud-based solution that improves customer experience while delivering valuable insights. With branded login pages, social sign-ins, and detailed reporting, Guest WiFi helps businesses engage customers, strengthen their brand, and unlock new marketing opportunities.

items.title: Enhance the Customer Experience
items.text: Create a smooth, professional first impression with fast, secure Guest WiFi. Branded login pages and simple access show customers your business values convenience, connectivity, and modern service.

items.title: Turn Data Into Business Growth
items.text: Guest WiFi captures visitor data in a GDPR-compliant way, helping you understand customer behaviour. Use these insights to personalise offers, run targeted campaigns, and drive repeat visits and increased revenue.
